usedFor: TxtSync holds your text contacts, and HubSpot stores them when “Create Contact” follows “New Contact Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Created” in TxtSync, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new text contact is copied into HubSpot, so sales sees them with the rest of your people.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs an email, so a TxtSync contact with only a phone number cannot be added.
